10k.note: 10-K describes commercialization of Ameluz (BF-200 ALA) for actinic keratosis with the RhodoLED PDT lamp, and ongoing label-expansion clinical programs in superficial basal cell carcinoma, acne vulgaris, and field-directed AK on extremities/neck/trunk.

website.note: Corporate site confirms positive Phase 2b acne vulgaris readout (March 9, 2026). Pipeline page redirects to product label.

ctgov.note: Three active company-sponsored P2/P3 studies (Biofrontera Inc. or Biofrontera Bioscience GmbH as lead sponsor); rest are completed legacy or partner-led.

pipeline.modality: Topical small molecule (5-aminolevulinic acid nanoemulsion gel) used with red-light photodynamic therapy (RhodoLED lamp)
pipeline.target: Protoporphyrin IX precursor; photodynamic cytotoxicity in dysplastic / hyperproliferative cells
pipeline.license_origin: Internal (developed by Biofrontera Bioscience GmbH; commercialized in US by Biofrontera Inc.)

indications.indication: Actinic keratosis (field-directed treatment on extremities, neck, and trunk)
indications.trial_design: Randomized, vehicle-controlled PDT study with RhodoLED lamp

excluded_legacy_terminated: NCT02799082, NCT04319159, NCT05060237, NCT01966120, NCT02799030, NCT02144077, NCT02799069 — completed legacy AK/BCC trials
excluded_partner_owned: NCT06577311 (sBCC investigator-initiated, Center for Clinical and Cosmetic Research as lead sponsor)
NCT06027619 (short-contact AK protocol, Case Comprehensive Cancer Center as lead sponsor)
NCT07053852 (BBL-HEROic activation IST, Sherrif Ibrahim as lead sponsor)

summary_counts.note_on_counts: phase_3/phase_2 counts reflect active indications, not assets; the asset count is 1 (Ameluz)
